measureSpo2HintCheck: Below 92%: please get this checked by a doctor, especially if you are short of breath.
measureSpo2HintUrgent: Below 90%: please seek medical advice promptly. Call emergency services if you are very short of breath, confused or your lips turn blue.
moodAnchorMild: Noticeable, but daily life goes fine
moodAnchorModerate: Daily life (work, family) only with clear effort
measureHowHint: Suggested from the name – tap to change.
symptomBlocksHint: Tap building blocks to compose the name. You can still edit it freely.
checkInHintMeasure: Record the current value. Description and location come from the symptom – “Change details” adjusts them for this check-in.
measureCountHint: How many times since the last check-in?
heatmapMapTemperature: Colour by temperature: raised from {elevated}, fever from {fever}, high fever from {high}, darkest from {max}.
heatmapMapRelative: Colour relative to the highest daily value ({max}).
heatmapMapBloodPressure: Colour by ESC/ESH category: high-normal, grade 1, 2, 3 hypertension.
heatmapMapSpo2: Colour by saturation: below 95%, 92%, 90%, 85% (lowest value of the day).
heatmapMapGlucose: Colour: outside the target range {low}–{high}; very low is darkest.
heatmapMapPulse: Colour: distance from the resting pulse range 60–100 bpm.
heatmapMapMood: Colour: distance from “balanced” (0) – the mood chart shows the direction.
journalPrivacy: Stays on your device. Included in the doctor PDF only if you switch it on there.
journalChartHint: Dots above the chart = journal entry. Tap to read.
summaryIncludeJournalSubtitle: Off by default – personal notes stay private.
unitsIntro: Values are always stored the same way – only the display is converted. Default by device region.
